name: Knights-Militant
text: You must recruit a Knight-Abbot to lead your warband. You begin the campaign with the Fortified Keep stronghold. Your warband can recruit any number of Cloister Knights.

name: Priesthood of Sorcerers
text: You must recruit a High Sorcerer to lead your warband. You begin the campaign with the Secluded Scriptorium stronghold. Your warband can recruit 0-2 Cloister Sorcerers.

name: The Anointed One
text: You must recruit a Knight-Abbot to lead your warband. You begin the campaign with the Unholy Altar stronghold. Your warband can recruit any number of Rot Demons.

name: Blessed Rabble
text: You must recruit a High Sorcerer to lead your warband. You begin the campaign with the Street Pulpit stronghold.
